label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (error-message-exposure) alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows into a log statement via the 'redacted' variable. Although a regex replaces 'password'|'token', the resolved sink value ('userInput=' + redacted) still depends on attacker-controlled input. Per instructions, partial mitigation does not override the vulnerability when attacker-controlled data reaches the sink.

evidence.note: User input 'param' flows to 'redacted' and is logged via warn(), retaining attacker-controlled content beyond simple keyword masking.
